mapper.sql: u.id AS id, u.unit_code AS code, u.unit_name AS name, u.parent_id AS parentId, p.unit_code AS parentCode, u.unit_level AS level, u.area_code AS areaCode, u.status AS status, u.version AS version, u.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_unit u LEFT JOIN sys_unit p ON p.id = u.parent_id ORDER BY u.unit_level, u.unit_code
SELECT id FROM sys_unit ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sys_unit u LEFT JOIN sys_unit p ON p.id = u.parent_id WHERE u.unit_code = CONVERT(#{code} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin
SELECT FROM sys_unit u LEFT JOIN sys_unit p ON p.id = u.parent_id WHERE u.id = #{id} FOR SHARE OF u
SELECT FROM sys_unit u LEFT JOIN sys_unit p ON p.id = u.parent_id ORDER BY u.unit_level, u.unit_code FOR SHARE OF u
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_unit (unit_code, unit_name, parent_id, unit_level, area_code, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{level}, #{areaCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ENABLED')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_unit SET unit_name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, unit_level = #{level}, area_code = #{areaCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
